title: Otori Emu — At A Stage Full Of Smiles〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: At A Stage Full Of Smiles（4★）

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was so good!
Hehe. I'm totally stuffed!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Your appetite's as big as ever.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's because Mr. Chef's so good at what he does. I really loved the Salisbury steaks he made for us today!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I'm sure it means a lot to a chef to see someone enjoy their dish so much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really want Sis to have some since she said before how she really likes the way these are seasoned.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: She mentioned that she wouldn't be home until late since she made plans with her university friends today...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Huh. Guess she's making the most of her time as a student.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I really wanted her to be here too...)

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Are you free to talk for a minute after this, Keisuke? I need to ask you something regarding tomorrow's meeting.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
I believe we're all finished eating, so let's...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, you guys, wait!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I've actually prepared a present for you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Please come in, Mr. Chef!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Oh, a cake. This is a nice surprise.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It even has two layers. This looks quite extravagant.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I actually baked and decorated it with the help of Mr. Chef here!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Wait, you made this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I know you guys love fruit, so I topped it with lots of them! I'm sure it turned out really yummy, so give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Then, let's talk after dessert, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: A little sugar for our brains should help our conversation go more smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Alright, Mr. Chef, please get the tea ready too!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Still, why prepare a cake...?
It's not like any of our birthdays are coming up.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Could it be that you want something from us?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hey, it's going to take more than cake to win us over.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, you've got it all wrong! I just wanted to do this to thank you guys!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Nothing more...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Nothing more!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, which part do you guys wanna have?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you want a slice from the top layer, or does the bottom look better?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, well...
Why don't you recommend a part to me, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Then, try to get me a slice with as many different fruits as you can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I hope they know I appreciate them...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It's okay for you to be a little more honest about how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, if you're feeling sad, then you should say that you're sad.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: To us... And your friends.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I can't say there's anything wrong with that, but... It's perfectly normal for you to feel sad.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: After all, they're your friends, and you put on shows with them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Even during that dream, they tried to encourage me.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They've always been really nice and showed me so much support...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Including when it came time for us to leave...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How's the cake? Good?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, it's just the right sweetness...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You did a pretty great job with this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Thank you guys so very much, Keisuke, Shosuke...!)

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Hey, quit staring at us like that.
You're making it hard to eat.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Ah, the tea's here. Emu, why don't you have some of this dessert as well?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!
